limitations: Recall measures complete annotated evidence, not Answer/Judge accuracy or official Overall; no paid model, official Smoke/Full or submission used.
All experiments are PUBLIC dev only; query/options/gold labels never enter Add; gold is used only for offline scoring.
Failures remain in requested-question denominators; complete comparisons use the corrected LME60 reruns, while legacy failed and interrupted runs are preserved separately.
Six LoCoMo histories contain correlated questions; the fixed first60 LME dev histories may not represent the benchmark mix. No significance or universal superiority claim.

All current responses were packed by the frozen250000-character service total cap and16000-character neighbor-window limit. Fewer than100 returned items alone cannot establish that the total cap was responsible. Offline regrading cannot recover omitted source text.
Production Answer model/prompt serialization is not disclosed; o200k_base primary, cl100k_base sensitivity, instruction reserves2048/512/8192 and chat64 are explicit token proxy assumptions.
